summary: The objective of our project is developing a safe and efficient route for exploration by astronauts as well as robotic exploration of the planet Mars. The core of our work is related to selecting the routes that will be safe enough for astronauts and robotic missions to follow and not to face any hazards including steep slopes, rocks, craters, and other possible difficulties. For this purpose we have designed a concept of route planning which is based on data about Mars surface. With the help of such data analysis and environmental hazards evaluation, we hope to make astronauts' travels on Mars safer and also enable astronauts and robotic exploration reach research stations. Our project is aimed at solving the problem of making the exploration of Mars safer and more effective. The choice of the route is crucial in case of Mars exploration since the planet has hostile environment, lacks of resources and contains many unknown threats.
details: This project was developed to design safe and efficient routes of exploration on Mars that can be used by astronauts and robots. It uses analysis of the surface conditions of the planet as well as potential dangers on the planet including craters, steepness, rocks, etc. This will help to find out the best route for exploration based on all these aspects. The advantages of this project include reduced risk of mission, less use of time and energy and safe arrival to key scientific locations. The goal of this project includes making future missions to Mars more reliable and the possibility of human exploration of the planet. The main factors that were taken into account while creating this project include such aspects as difficulties of the terrain, safety of the surface, potential obstacles and effectiveness of the route. This project is creative since it combines scientific mission and safe route design using information about the surface of the planet. The project uses digital mapping of Mars, its surface and routes.
